name: dsh-rightbar-diff-split
description: Local persistent Web UI patch: the right panel's 变更审阅 (changes-review) diff is kept continuously aligned with the panel's fullscreen state — side-by-side exactly when fullscreen, unified otherwise. State-following, not a hotkey: the plugin subscribes to the live layout store (layoutInfo.rightbarFullscreen), the session-scoped rightbar store (current pane's active tab) and the changes-review view store, and re-aligns on every notification plus once at load, reading the fullscreen value and the current tab's `split` and calling the same `toggledSplit` action the header button uses only when they disagree (read-then-toggle, so it is idempotent). Because that action is a toggle and the store flushes synchronously, the correction lands in the very same notification stack, so the header button degrades into a read-only state indicator (clicking it visibly does nothing). No polling, no timers, no DOM access or CSS. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild).
